get.summary: Start Sign in with GitHub; redirects to GitHub
GitHub returns here; the person becomes a session and goes back to the dashboard
Who is signed in and in which workspace; 401 otherwise. With ZENTHOS_AUTH=off, the anonymous marker in the dry-run workspace

post.summary: End the session and clear the cookie

get.summary: The workspaces the signed-in person belongs to, with their role in each and which one the session is in

post.summary: Create a workspace; the creator owns it and the session moves into it
Work in this workspace from now on; refused unless the person is a member

get.summary: The members of a workspace the person belongs to

put.summary: Invite a GitHub login into the workspace, or change their role; owners only, and the last owner stays

delete.summary: Remove a member; owners only, and the last owner stays

get.summary: Whether the platform GitHub App is set up, its slug and where it installs

post.summary: Start creating the platform app from the manifest: a page that submits it to GitHub. Takes the setup token the API printed at boot

get.summary: GitHub returns here with the manifest code; the app becomes the platform app and the browser goes to the dashboard

post.summary: Make an app created by hand on GitHub the platform app: app id, private key, webhook secret and the OAuth client for Sign in with GitHub. Takes the setup token

get.summary: The installations this workspace has claimed, with the repositories each covers
Install the platform app on an account or organisation for this workspace; redirects to GitHub
GitHub returns here after an install; the installation is claimed for the workspace and the browser goes back to the dashboard settings

delete.summary: Release an installation from this workspace; the app stays installed on GitHub until its owner removes it there

get.summary: A repository one of the workspace's installations covers, as GitHub sees it: default branch and clone URL, for the profile form
Whether this workspace has a model provider key, which provider and its last four characters; never the key itself

put.summary: Enter or replace the workspace's Anthropic API key: checked with Anthropic first, then stored sealed; owners and admins

delete.summary: Remove the workspace's key; its runs fall back to the deployment's own credentials, if any; owners and admins

put.summary: Create or replace a repository profile; gate commands must be allowed commands

get.summary: The newest run for a ticket, or the newest runs of the workspace, newest first

post.summary: Start a run for a ticket of one of the workspace's repositories (idempotent per ticket)
Approve or reject the current spec draft
GitHub App webhook: labels start and decide runs, installation events update the connection

get.summary: Every metric, with its definition beside its value: from the stored runs, the eval metrics from the latest eval runs in LangFuse; null where neither is the source
Compare one run's stored cost per agent with what LangFuse recorded for its session
Every term the product uses, with its definition, kind, relations and deciding ADR
